text_block_list.text: Oh noooo! I wonder where I left them...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I made a lot of flyers for today's street

performance!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You don't think someone took all of
them, do
you?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: No! One flyer per person! I am everyone's Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон exhausts herself running
around
looking for the paper bags full of
her flyers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
